scope: Selected analyte conversions only; this is not a UCUM parser or a diagnostic reference range.
caseRule: Unit symbols are matched exactly and never case-folded, because a symbol's case can change its magnitude: Mmol/L is not mmol/L, MU/L is not mU/L, and G/L (giga per litre) is not g/L (gram per litre), so g/L has no upper-case spelling. The only equivalences are the spellings listed here: the all-lower and all-upper rendering a single-case report prints, and the litre as L or l. `aliases` and `caseVariants` together are the closed vocabulary of units a quote must print, beside the value they qualify, in one of the spellings listed for the unit; a unit outside them is required literally only for a laboratory value or when it is written as a ratio, a power or a percentage.
